snippet.title: Lily's World XD - Official Game Overview Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Game Overview Trailer for Lily's World XD, a visual immersive horror game developed by SonderingEmily. Players will explore the computer of an early 2000s teen from reading her conversations, making edits to her blog, and become unsettled by some messages being addressed to the player itself. Lily's World XD is coming soon to PC (Steam).
